## The v3.1 envelope defect (reproduced from exact tracked bytes)
result-envelope-schema-v3.1.json validation_rules:
  [0] 'envelope is committed BY THE LEAF at the frozen owned path in the SAME result commit'
  [2] 'controller verifies envelope.result_tree_sha == git rev-parse <result_head>^{tree}'
acceptance-verifier-v3.1.py check_envelope:
  head_tree = git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; 'result_tree_sha_matches': env.get('result_tree_sha') == head_tree
Facts:
  - envelope required in SAME result commit
  - envelope.result_tree_sha required to equal result_head^{tree}
  - verifier compares envelope result_tree_sha with git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}
  - the envelope blob is an INPUT of HEAD^{tree} -> hash_dependency_cycle=true
  - schema labels result_tree_sha as 'SHA-256'; verifier obtains a Git object ID via rev-parse -> algorithm_semantics_ambiguous=true
  - operationally_non_constructible_under_normal_git_workflow=true; cryptographic_fixed_point_would_be_required=true (no claim that a fixed point is absolutely impossible)
Controlled Git experiment (T1->T2->T3): writing the envelope declaring T1 changes the tree to T2; declaring T2 changes it to T3; T1 != T2 != T3 -> same_commit_binding_not_stable=true.

## The v3.2 correction (TWO-COMMIT MODEL)
Per leaf, EXACTLY two commits over the candidate:
  C = candidate head (CANDIDATE_HEAD 50953878...)
  R = IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT_HEAD: parent(R)=C; contains owned implementation, tests, tracked provenance; NO envelope.
  E = ENVELOPE_CONTAINER_HEAD: parent(E)=R; contains EXACTLY the frozen envelope; NO implementation change.
  The remote leaf branch points to E. The ONLY integration-eligible commit is R. E is evidence and never integrated.
The v3.2 envelope declares: schema (headless-lab-result-envelope/v3.2), lab, batch_id, leaf_id, lease_id,
  candidate_commit_oid (== R^), implementation_result_commit_oid (== R), implementation_result_tree_oid (== R^{tree}),
  git_object_format (== git rev-parse --show-object-format), external_branch_binding (planned only),
  literal_tests, build_provenance, artifacts (files present in R only).
Forbidden self-binding: E commit OID, E tree OID, envelope blob OID, envelope SHA-256, resolved remote branch SHA
  are recorded EXTERNALLY by the controller after push. Git object IDs are named *_commit_oid/*_tree_oid/git_object_format;
  'SHA-256' is reserved for ordinary file hashes (_sha256).
